rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: bank below 500, workers at target, and at least 3 hatcheries with active larvae.
rules.correction: Spend bank on hatcheries (up to 3 bases total) and inject larvae with queens; queue drones from all hatcheries until worker count reaches 38-44, but keep at least 2 larvae in reserve for defensive units if threat is detected.
rules.title: Maintain Zerg production tempo and worker saturation
rules.when: At any time before 6 minutes, if bank is above 800 minerals and either (a) active larvae plus hatchery count is below 3, or (b) workers are below 32 by 4 minutes or below 38 by 5 minutes.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: roach count at least 12, roach warren completed, and army supply above 30.
rules.correction: Prioritize building roach warren if not already completed, then queue roaches from all hatcheries until you have at least 12 roaches; ensure you have enough supply (build overlords if needed) and keep 2-3 queens for creep and defense.
rules.title: Counter Protoss ground composition with roaches
rules.when: If enemy intelligence shows a ground-heavy Protoss army (Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, or Immortals) and your army supply is below 30, or if you have fewer than 6 roaches.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: army supply above 25, bank below 800, and production capacity (hatcheries + larvae) sufficient to sustain unit production.
rules.correction: Immediately convert bank into combat units: queue zerglings and roaches from all hatcheries, prioritizing roaches if enemy has stalkers/immortals; build additional hatcheries if larvae are insufficient, and ensure supply is not blocked by building overlords if needed.
rules.title: Recover from low army and high bank
rules.when: If army supply is below 15 and bank is above 1500 minerals, or if predicted advantage is OverwhelmingDisadvantage.
